column1: # Per-league Tip 1 hitrate, replayed as-of on the current build over the
# league's most recent fixtures — up to 800, capped at two seasons. Written
# by scripts/retrosim.py (27 Aug 2026, published says with every debit, on
# the final per-league floors); read by scripts/league_badges.py and the
# app's Retrosim page. buy = the average buy-from a card would have printed
# for that league's tips — a league can hit 90% and still be unbuyable.
